forecasts.why: Reproducing a previously reported cross-validated AUC is typically a straightforward verification step with a high success rate.
The milestone is designed to confirm a failure (holdout_auc < 0.71) of an inherited analysis, which is a highly likely outcome in re-analysis projects.
The preceding milestone 'miss' already establishes that the holdout AUC is below the floor, leaving only the gap criteria to be satisfied.
The refuted downstream milestones (compact-forest and compact-knn) both report cv_auc values above 0.7 and n_features of 50, implying the screen milestone was already successfully reached.
The random forest, typically a stronger learner than k-NN, already failed the holdout_auc threshold of 0.71 with the same feature set.
The prerequisite screen milestone is open and requires a similar AUC and feature count, suggesting the data is likely to support the forest's criteria.
The failure of compact-forest and compact-knn suggests that the current feature screen is insufficient to reliably hit the holdout AUC threshold of 0.71.
Both individual models (forest and knn) failed to reach the 0.71 holdout AUC threshold, making it unlikely their ensemble will succeed.
Other models on the same screened features (forest, knn) failed the holdout AUC threshold, but gradient boosting is generally more powerful and the goal was already reached via other paths.
The goal floor has already been reached via floor-selected-forest, and a random forest on all features is likely to overfit the pilot data, leading to a gap that violates the criteria.
The previous milestone 'nested' failed to reach the AUC floor with a value of 0.56, suggesting that L1-penalised logistic regression is unlikely to jump to 0.71.
The goal 'floor' has already been reached via 'floor-selected-forest', and 'floor-search' is a broader search that includes the successful random forest approach.
The agent is running a baseline analysis on a held-out set to verify a previously reported cross-validated result, which typically has a high likelihood of being reasonably consistent.
The previous baseline and fixed analyses yielded AUCs around 0.56, and a simple fix to the RF prediction method is unlikely to jump the performance to 0.71.
The agent's expectations are based on previous pilot-only exploration results that already showed honest CV AUCs in the 0.74-0.78 range.
The agent's search already yielded a cv_auc of 0.759, and the 3x5 nested CV is a refinement of the same procedure, making it highly likely to stay above 0.7.
The agent has a strong, honest nested CV estimate of 0.755 on the pilot and prior evidence from similar routes suggests the stability screen generalizes well to the held-out set.
The agent has an honest nested CV estimate of 0.73, but acknowledges that individual models failed the floor, making the 0.71 holdout target a plausible but uncertain outcome.
The agent has performed extensive pilot-only refinement and preflight nested CV, suggesting the model is stable and likely to generalize to the held-out set.
The agent has refined the hyperparameters based on multi-seed pilot CV and the previous run showed a very small gap between CV and holdout, making a result just above 0.71 likely.
The agent has identified a specific coding bug and the preliminary fold AUCs suggest the performance targets are achievable.
Previous attempts with similar configurations reached a holdout AUC of 0.6989, and while tuning may help, hitting the 0.71 threshold is a tight margin.
The agent has already verified the specific parameters (K=25, default RF) across multiple seeds in step-41, showing consistent holdout AUCs above 0.73.
The agent has failed multiple attempts to reach the 0.7 AUC threshold on the pilot data, suggesting the signal is weaker than expected or the feature selection is ineffective.
The agent has repeatedly failed to reach the 0.70 AUC threshold across multiple diverse SVM and screening strategies, suggesting a performance ceiling for this model class on the pilot data.
The agent has spent several steps establishing a realistic performance ceiling around 0.66-0.68, making the expectation of cv_auc >= 0.66 highly probable.
